### Match P. trichocarpa vs P. tremula gene ID

```{r}
ptr_matches <- read.table(params$path_ptremula_best_hit)
colnames(ptr_matches) <- c(
    "Query_accession",
    "Target_accession",
    "Sequence_identity",
    "Length",
    "Mismatches",
    "Gap_openings",
    "Query_start",
    "Query_end",
    "Target_start",
    "Target_end",
    "E_value",
    "Bit_score"
)
dim(ptr_matches); head(ptr_matches)
```

Filter match results

```{r}
ptr_best_matches <- ptr_matches %>% 
  arrange(Query_accession, desc(Sequence_identity)) %>%
  distinct(Query_accession, .keep_all = TRUE)
dim(ptr_best_matches)

# 
ptr_rbest_matches <- ptr_best_matches %>% 
  arrange(Target_accession, desc(Sequence_identity)) %>%
  distinct(Target_accession, .keep_all = TRUE)
dim(ptr_rbest_matches)

# show result
head(ptr_rbest_matches)
```

Show the distribution of sequence similarity

```{r}
ptr_rbest_matches %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = Sequence_identity)) + 
    geom_histogram(binwidth=.5) +
    theme_classic() + 
    labs(title = "
Sequence similarity
of P. trichocarpa & P. tremula reciprocal best-hits
    ")
```

```{r}
ptr_rbest_matches_90 <- subset(ptr_rbest_matches, ptr_rbest_matches$Sequence_identity > 90)
ptr_rbest_matches_90$Target_accession %<>% sapply(function(x){sub("[0-9]*[.]p", "v4.1", x)})
ptr_rbest_matches_90$Query_accession %<>% sapply(function(x){sub("[.][0-9]*[.]p", "", x)})
tremula_2_trichocarpa <- as.vector(ptr_rbest_matches_90$Target_accession)
names(tremula_2_trichocarpa) <- ptr_rbest_matches_90$Query_accession
head(ptr_rbest_matches_90)
```

## Plot marker expressions

Get marker orthogroups

```{r}
get_cla_ortholog <- function(cla_id) {
  species_prefix <- switch(
    params$sample_id %>% substr(1, 3),
    "egr" = "Eucgr",
    "ptr" = "Potri",
    "lch" = "Lchi",
    "tar" = "evm"
  )
  species_suffix <- switch(
    params$sample_id %>% substr(1, 3),
    "egr" = ".v2.0",
    "ptr" = ".v4.1",
    "lch" = "",
    "tar" = ""
  )
  ortho_line <- system2(command = "grep", args = c("Cula0006341", params$path_shuai_orthogroups), stdout = TRUE)
  ortho_line %>% strsplit(" ") %>% unlist %>% grep(species_prefix, ., value = TRUE) %>% paste0(species_suffix)
}
```

Plot helper

```{r}
plot_marker <- function(features, title) {
  DotPlot(
    seurat_obj, 
    features = features,
    assay = "RNA",
    cols = "Blues",
    scale = TRUE,
    dot.min = 0
  ) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
      colours = c("grey95", "#9ecae1", "#3182bd", "#08519c")
    ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = title
  )
}
```

```{r}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(known_markers))) {
  # get row slice
  row_i <- known_markers[i, ]
  gid <- row_i$Published.identifier
  species <- row_i$Species...assay.host
  markers <- NULL

  if (grepl("POPTR", gid)) {
    message("Phytozome down")
    next
  }
  
  # check if published id is available
  if(nchar(gid) == 0) {
    message("Empty identifier: ", row_i$Record)
    next
  }
  
  # if is P. tremula id
  if (species == "Populus tremula x P. tremuloides (T89)") {
    message("PlantGenie is down; no reference genome available for P tremula v2.2") # temp
    next
    gid <- ptr_rbest_matches_90 %>% filter(Query_accession == gid) %>% pull(Target_accession)
  }
  
  idx <- grep(gid, orthogroup$gene_name)
  if (identical(idx, integer(0))) {
    message("Un-grep'ed")
  } else {
    cid <- orthogroup[idx, "cluster_id"] %>% unique
    markers <- orthogroup %>%
      filter(
        cluster_id %in% cid,
        species_name == switch(
          substr(params$sample_id, 1, 3),
          "ptr" = "PoT",
          "egr" = "EuG",
          "lch" = "LiC",
          "tar" = "TrA"
        )
      ) %>% 
      pull(gene_name)
    if (identical(markers, character(0))) {
      message("No ortholog")
      next
    }
  }
  
  
  if (is.null(markers) | identical(markers, character(0))) {
    message("Null markers")
    next
  } else {
    p <- plot_marker(
        markers, 
        title = row_i$Original.reported.cell.state
      ) +
      labs(
        subtitle = row_i$Study,
        caption = row_i$Record
      )
    save_fig(
      p, 
      file.path(
        params$path_output, 
        sprintf("%s_%s.svg", row_i$Record, params$sample_id)
      ),
      width = 8,
      height = 4 + length(markers) * 0.2
    )
    print(p)
  }
}
```
